result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\. They both provide secure password sharing, team vaults and centralised access management, but they differ in ease of use and price.

Here's how I'd rank them for a small business in 2026.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password** (Best overall)

# \$24.95 USD/month

Teams Starter Pack · Up to 10 users

- Excellent, intuitive interface.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Easy onboarding and offboarding.
- Security alerts and password health monitoring.
- Great for non-technical teams.

Website: [1Password Business](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

# \$4 USD/user/month

Teams plan · Annual billing

- Open-source software.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Audit and event logs.
- Directory integration and SCIM.
- Excellent value for technically minded teams.

Website: [Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Security**

# \$2 USD/user/month

Business Starter · Annual billing

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Good security and compliance features.
- Worth considering for businesses with stricter security requirements.

Website: [Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

# \$4.49 USD/user/month

Professional plan · Annual pricing

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Secure sharing.
- Useful for teams already using Proton services.
- Good option for privacy-conscious businesses.

Website: [Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are indicative published USD prices, generally on annual billing, before tax. Verify current Australian pricing at checkout. ## My recommendation

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall experience | 1Password |
| Lowest cost with good features | Bitwarden |
| More advanced security administration | Keeper |
| Privacy-focused environment | Proton Pass |


Personally, I'd narrow it down to **1Password vs Bitwarden**\.

For a small business, usability matters enormously. You want staff to actually use the password manager rather than continue sharing passwords through email, spreadsheets or Slack.
